# ZipWriter

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

ZIP archive writer with configurable entry options. Errors are reported through Error.Last().

[Behavior, defaults and examples](../zip.md).

## Abort

```PPL
ZipWriter.Abort() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Discards the temporary archive without publishing it.

## AddBytes

```PPL
ZipWriter.AddBytes(BYTES data, STRING entryName) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Adds binary data under the specified relative archive name.

## AddDirectory

```PPL
ZipWriter.AddDirectory(STRING entryName) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Adds a directory entry with a relative archive name.

## AddFile

```PPL
ZipWriter.AddFile(STRING sourcePath, [STRING entryName]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Adds a regular source file under the optional relative archive name.

## AddTree

```PPL
ZipWriter.AddTree(STRING sourceDirectory, [STRING prefix], [BOOLEAN recursive]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Adds a source directory under an optional archive prefix, optionally including subdirectories. The archive output must be outside the source tree.

## Finish

```PPL
ZipWriter.Finish() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Finalizes the archive and publishes it at the destination. Returns success; errors update Error.Last().

## Level

`ZipWriter.Level: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Current compression method or level for subsequent entries.

## Method

`ZipWriter.Method: ZipMethod`

Read-only instance property.

Current compression method or level for subsequent entries.

## SetComment

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetComment(STRING text, [ZipEncoding encoding]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets the archive comment using the selected text encoding.

## SetCompression

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetCompression(ZipMethod method, [INTEGER level]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets the compression method and optional level for subsequent entries.

## SetPermissions

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetPermissions([INTEGER mode]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets Unix permission bits for subsequent entries. Omit mode to restore defaults.

## SetTimestamp

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetTimestamp([DATE date], [TIME time]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets the ZIP entry timestamp from native nonempty DATE and TIME values (1980..2107). ZIP truncates subseconds and odd seconds. Omit both arguments to reset the override; errors leave it unchanged and update Error.Last().

## SetTimestampUtc

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetTimestampUtc(TIMESTAMP timestamp) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets the ZIP entry timestamp from UTC components (1980..2107). ZIP truncates subseconds and odd seconds. Empty resets the override; errors leave it unchanged.

## SetZip64

```PPL
ZipWriter.SetZip64(Zip64Mode mode) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Selects automatic ZIP64 support or rejects entries requiring ZIP64.

## Valid

`ZipWriter.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

True while the writer is open and has not failed or been cancelled.
